description: The ready queue is ordered by the release chain, with no priority to set (design part 2.4, HITLD-995): the work the nearest release needs goes first, a stray priority key changes nothing, and work no release needs is listed apart with how long it has waited. When the owner wants other work sooner, the chief of staff records the choice as a decision and the owner's steer is a change to a release's needs, after which the queue follows the graph.
